external_sources.imported_statement: A smooth connected solvable algebraic group acting on a nonempty complete separated algebraic scheme over an algebraically closed field has a fixed point. Applied to two upper-triangular groups acting on a projective orbit closure in a Grassmannian.
external_sources.read: Statement, standing hypotheses, proof, warning about smoothness/completeness, and version cover read in this session.

prior_credit: Classical scalar Hankel annihilators and the maintained source-rank/coefficient-injection arguments retain their prior local and external attribution. The proof supplies the tangent, closed-condition, Ferrers and conormal-incidence deductions without claiming historical priority.
local_work: Projection codimension budgets via a Borel-fixed Ferrers limit; proper large sections of the rank-seven Hankel variety; rank-three exclusion of two ordinary A(8,9) targets; exact finite controls.
field_and_hypotheses: Algebraically closed characteristic-zero field. Complex ordinary source restrictions, extended to the algebraic closure of C(u,v) using polynomial parameter identities. No singular degeneration claim.
